name: blender-cli
title_zh: 先翻离线API证据再动手的Blender命令行助手
tagline_zh: 模型记错Blender API是常事——它不猜，先翻随包的功能目录和离线Python证据，查不到就明说不会。
tagline_en: LLMs misremember Blender APIs—this one won't guess. It checks bundled feature catalog + offline Python evidence.
desc_en: Implement Blender CLI tasks from a bundled feature catalog and offline Python API evidence. Discover capabilities before querying APIs; reject Blender facts or recipes supplied only by model memory.
why_zh: 把「模型记忆」降级为最后手段，一切以离线证据为准。能查才答，查不到就停，从机制上掐断编造API的幻觉。
why_en: Demotes model memory to last resort—answers only what offline evidence supports. Stops cold when unsure, structurally killing.
limit_zh: 只认Blender CLI任务；不覆盖Blender Python脚本编写、不处理建模/渲染操作。
limit_en: Blender CLI tasks only—no Python scripting, no GUI ops. Requires local Blender accessible via CLI. Offline catalog is version-fixed; unlisted newer.
title_en: Blender CLI copilot that checks offline API docs first
